result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: a truncated restaurant name in the Fastest near you carousel and missing restaurant details under the partially visible pizza promo card.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off at the end of the visible card in the Fastest near you row, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or allow enough width so full names like 'Trattoria Piccola' display completely without clipping.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card shows only the image and -20% badge with no restaurant name, delivery time, fee, or cuisine info (unlike the Tokumaru Ramen card above it).
issues.suggestion: Add the standard restaurant metadata (name, ETA, delivery cost, category, rating) below the image for consistency, or ensure it appears when the card is fully in view.
